title: LIMBO - Dimension
description: A cosmic horror and dark fantasy inspired dimension expansion pack
body:
# LIMBO [​26.2] - A Cosmic Horror Dimension Expansion Datapack
_Created by: Zackattack4100 (MC username) / MoisturePack (PMC/Modrinth username)_

Planet Minecraft Link: [Limbo 26.2 Planet Minecraft](https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/limbo-26-2-a-cosmic-horror-dimension-addition/)

> _"Some stories are better left untold."_

Beyond the Overworld, beyond the Nether, even beyond The End, there exists another place.

**Limbo is a massive, multi-player-friendly, endgame dimension expansion for Minecraft Java Edition 26.2.**

**Limbo** Introduces an entirely new world to explore, survive, and hopefully escape from... Inspired by themes like _cosmic horror_, _dark fantasy_, _isolation_, and _adventure_, **Limbo** is a place that shouldn't exist. Not Hell. Not Heaven. Just... somewhere in between.

## A New Dimension
**Limbo** is a fully realized custom dimension featuring
- 22 unique biomes
- Custom structures
- New enchantments
- Rare relic items
- Hidden secrets
- Dangerous exploration and enemies

### Unique Achievements

- Press the advancement tab key (usually "L") when starting your world to help you get started.
- Those willing to explore may also discover rich mineral deposits, including naturally generating Ancient Debris.

### Dimensional Utlilty

- Quick travel to and from **Limbo** makes it easy to use Limbo as a warehouse or storage area...


## Explore 22 Distinct Biomes
Journey through eerie landscapes such as
- The Plains
- The Pine Bend
- The Sorrowlands
- The Crystal Peaks
- The Crossroads
- The Depths
- The Wraithwood
- And many more...

Every biome tells a different story. Some are unsettling, some are hiding things you were never supposed to find.

**For a list of all current biomes and images, see gallary**

## New Enchantments
Scattered throughout **Limbo's** structures are 25 brand-new enchantments that cannot be obtained anywhere else.

Search abandoned mineshafts.

Investigate forgotten fortresses.

Raid ancient ruins.

If you're lucky, you may discover powers long lost to the Overworld.

Among these enchantments are 6 unique Elytra enchantments, opening entirely new possibilities for exploration, movement and combat.


<details>
<summary>Full Enchantment List</summary>

## Helmet

### True Sight
- Grants immunity to Blindness, Darkness and Nausea.
- Reveals the health bar of the nearest entity within 10 blocks.
- Press the 'sneak' key and 'sprint' key simultaneously to highlight the currently targeted entity.


## Chestplate

### Isolation
- 25% chance when taking damage to knock back the attacker.


## Elytra

### Slipstream
- Increases maximum flight speed and momentum retention.
- _Incompatible with: Weightless_

### Afterburner
- Press or hold the 'sprint' key while gliding to gain a forward speed boost.
- Consumes 1 durability per second while active.
- _Incompatible with: Weightless_

### Updraft
- Press or hold the 'jump' key while gliding to slowly float upwards.
- Consumes 1 durability per second while active.

### Air Brake
- Press or hold the 'sneak' key while gliding to rapidly reduce speed.
- Decreases momentum damage received while "braking".

### Landfall
- Press and hold Forward, Left, and Right simultaneously while gliding to begin a rapid descent.
- Creates a powerful explosion upon ground impact.
- Deals 20 durability damage per slam and 1 durability per second while descending.
- _Incompatible with: Weightless_

### Weightless
- Reduces gravity while wearing the elytra.
- Allows for self-sustaining flight and greatly improves aerial persistence.
- Reduces top speed.
- _Incompatible with: Slipstream, Afterburner, Landfall_


## Leggings

### Wanderer
- Slightly increases base movement speed.
- Allows the wearer to step-up 1 block.


## Boots

### Dash
- Press the 'jump' key while airborne (and not gliding with an elytra) to dash the direction your looking or inputting (supports omni-directional inputs).
- Doing a dash will prevent you from taking fall damage.
- Costs 1 durability per dash.
- _Incompatible with: Double Jump_

### Double Jump
- Press the 'jump' key while airborne (and not gliding with an elytra) to be boosted upwards and slightly forwards.
- Doing a double jump will prevent you from taking fall damage.
- Costs 1 durability per Double Jump.
- _Incompatible with: Dash_


## Bow

### Storm Caller
- Causes lightning to strike wherever the arrow lands or when hitting a target.
- Arrows deal slightly reduced damage.
- Arrows cannot be recovered after hitting a block.
- _Incompatible with: Barrage, Ranger_

### Barrage
- Fires a spread of arrows instead of a single projectile.
- Covers a larger area but each arrow deals slightly reduced damage.
- Arrows cannot be recovered after hitting a block.
- _Incompatible with: Storm Caller, Ranger_

### Ranger
- Increases arrow velocity for longer-range shots.
- Slightly increases damage.
- Arrows pierce one target.
- _Incompatible with: Barrage, Storm Caller, Power 1-5_


## Crossbow

### Ballista
- Increases reload time to 2 seconds.
- Greatly increases projectile velocity and damage.
- Arrows travel without drop.
- _Incompatible with: Ordnance, Multishot, Quick Charge_

### Ordnance
- Arrows explode on impact and set blocks on fire.
- Arrows cannot be recovered after hitting a block.
- _Incompatible with: Ballista, Piercing_


## Sword

### Envy
- Restores the classic pre-1.9 attack style, allowing rapid consecutive attacks without cooldown.


## Spear

### Lunge IV
- Hold Sprint while attacking to perform a powerful lunge in the direction you're facing.
- Does not cause exhaustion.
- Removes normal vertical movement restrictions during lunge.
- _This version of lunge cannot be acquired by combining lunge books 1-3 and is incompatible with the normal lunge enchantment_

### Storm Dancer
- Hitting a target while moving at least 15 blocks per second causes a lightning strike.
- Grants immunity to lightning while held.


## Any Enchantable Weapon

### Gluttony
- 25% chance on hit to restore hunger and saturation.
- 25% chance to inflict a short Hunger effect on the target.

### Greed
- 25% chance on hit to spawn experience orbs.
- 10% chance on hit to spawn raw gold.

### Lust
- 20% chance on hit to generate a Small Wind Charge.
- 10% chance on hit to generate a Large Wind Charge.
- Small charges emit white particles.
- Large charges emit black particles.
- Generated charges can be used by any player.
- **Can also be applied to bows**

### Wrath
- 5% chance on hit to trigger a massive critical hit dealing 50 damage (25 hearts).

### Pride
- The faster you move, the more damage you deal.
- Features four power levels represented by unique hit particles when striking an entity.


## Any Enchantable Item

### Forsaken
- While inside Limbo, the enchanted item repairs itself at a rate of 2 durability per second.
</details>

## Entering **Limbo**
Your journey begins with a mysterious artifact
### **The Limbo Key**
Hidden within various vanilla structures, the **Limbo** **Key** serves as your gateway into the dimension.

Right click it and you'll enter Limbo...

But be warned.

The key is consumed upon use.

And once you arrive, **Limbo** becomes your new spawn point (until you find a new key / way out).

Fortunately, those who search carefully may find additional keys hidden throughout **Limbo** itself... assuming they survive long enough.


<details>
<summary>Full list of structures that can spawn a Limbo Key</summary>

- Mineshafts

- Ancient Cities

- Bastions

- Buried Treasure

- Desert Pyramid

- End Cities

- Jungle Temples

- Nether Fortresses

- Pillager Outposts

- Ruined Portals

- Shipwrecks

- Dungeons

- Stronghold Libraries

- Large Underwater Ruins

- Small Underwater Ruins

- Villages

- Woodland Mansions
</details>


## Ancient Relics
Deep within the many biomes of **Limbo** are powerful relics.

Rare statues occasionally appear throughout the world, each guarding treasures lost to time. Finding one is exceptionally rare.

Current relics include (more to be added with future updates)
- **Master Key** - Travel freely between worlds without consuming the key or setting your spawn, making it great for travel.
- **Tomb of Oblivion** - A cursed book with the power to banish creatures and players to Limbo or vice versa (10 minute in game cooldown).
- **Edge of Eternity** - A shard of reality shaped into an arrow, with the power to instantly kill whatever is hit by it.

_These artifacts are not meant to be common rewards…_

## Hidden Secrets
Not everything in **Limbo** is obvious.

Not every structure serves the purpose you think it does.

Not every biome has revealed all of its mysteries.

Some answers are buried deep beneath the surface.

Others are watching from the darkness.

**_The less you know before entering, the better the experience._**

## How to Install
To install **Limbo** you must first create a new world, as it is not currently possible to add dimensions to your world after it has been created.

## Compatibility
Limbo was designed to be compatible with **Artemis**, **Hellscape** and **Endeavor**!

## How to update Limbo after its been installed in your world
To update **Limbo** in the future, all you have to do is open your world's datapacks folder, then delete the folder called **Limbo** and then drag the new **Limbo** folder into the datapack folder, then your done!

## Feedback
I am just 1 person working on this project, so if you want to leave feed back I'm more than happy to hear it!

If you encounter any bugs or other glitches you believe are not intentional, please message me on Discord/Planet Minecraft.

## A Supported Project
This project is planned to be supported into future versions of Minecraft, making it reliable if you plan on using it on a server.
